title.zh: 将东萨马省巴朗卡延市镇的坎图比小村改设为名称为坎图比村的正规村的法案
title.en: An Act Converting Sitio Cantubi in the Municipality of Balangkayan in the Province of Eastern Samar Into a Regular Barrio to Be Known as Barrio Cantubi
title.orig: An Act Converting Sitio Cantubi in the Municipality of Balangkayan in the Province of Eastern Samar Into a Regular Barrio to Be Known as Barrio Cantubi

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1971/ra_6214_1971.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Cantubi in the Municipality of Balangkayan in the Province of Eastern Samar is hereby converted into a regular barrio to be known as Barrio Cantubi.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
